name: sia-connector
description: The Sia WhatsApp watcher — Baileys ear, wag_ database writer. READ-ONLY: this process never sends a WhatsApp message.

scripts.start: trap 'echo; echo [watcher] stopped; exit 0' INT TERM; while true; do tsx src/index.ts; echo '[watcher] restarting in 2s (crash-only)'; sleep 2; done
